_note: Single source for models, prices, budget and gate settings. Prices are $ per million tokens from the Nous route catalogue (2026-11-01); the pipeline logs the provider's real cost for every call.

anthropic/claude-opus-5.5._note: assumed equal to claude-opus-5 until checked on the Nous price list

budget_usd._note: Hesham 2026-11-02: about 90 reels a month (3 a day) at premium quality, about $1.10 per reel on average, $100 a month.

asr._note: hyperframes transcribe accepts tiny/base/small/medium/large-v3 (not large-v3-turbo; checked 2026-11-01, v0.8.226)

gates._note: Autopilot (Hesham, 2026-11-01): only the draft needs him. Words are fixed by commenting 'old => new'; the best-scored story is picked automatically. Set transcript_review true / story_pick 'ask' to bring the gates back.

tools._note: Pinned so old reels re-render identically. Upgrade only between jobs.

sound._note: Every draft/final/CapCut video: light voice clean-up, then two-pass loudness to the social-media level.

broll_ai._note: T123 (Hesham approved the cost 2026-11-02): each new library picture is described once by the vision model; each reel makes one small text call to pick matching files. Set enabled false to switch off.

roles._note: One place that decides which AI does which job (T136). Brain = Sonnet 5.5; Haiku 5.5 = words and QA (Hesham 2026-11-03). Effort = how long it thinks. The 'models' list is built from these roles.

word_fix.note: fixes mistakes in the raw words

repair.note: fixes a plan that breaks rules; also the revision after the critic

critic.note: (T134) QA: looks at the draft and scores it (Hesham 2026-11-03)

cover.note: (T128+) picks the cover frame and words

icon_tags.note: (T149) one-time Arabic tags for the big icon library

outline._note: T130: one Sonnet call per reel (about $0.14) finds hook/steps/recap before the director plans. Set enabled false to switch off.

critic._note: T134: Haiku looks at ~8 stills of the draft and scores it (about $0.002). Report only for now. Set enabled false to switch off.

format_pack._note: T129: when the outline finds an explainer or tips reel with enough sections, the reel gets ONE designed frame (header, face window, step panel with progress, recap chain) instead of loose cards. mode: auto | off | always. theme: dark | violet.
format_pack._closing_note: Closing like / subscribe / follow buttons under the recap chain. OFF because the project rule keeps the call to action off (AGENTS.md, Hesham 2026-11-01); set closing_buttons true to switch on.
